label: Single gull cry
driver: Occasional nearby bird event; position and distance follow the bird
prompt: One solitary wild gull heard clearly from the deck of a wooden sailing ship. A single short natural calling phrase lasting about one second: a nasal descending gull cry with a breathy raspy throat texture and irregular pitch. Brief quiet before, then the entire natural decay into quiet afterward. Isolated outdoor bird recording; only this one gull call is audible.

label: Distant seabird calls
driver: Sparse distant bird activity, with long randomized gaps between events
prompt: One solitary gull far from a wooden sailing ship gives two faint natural cries separated by two seconds of quiet. Distant softened nasal bird calls with a dry open-air perspective and very little high-frequency detail. Quiet before and after. The entire recording contains only these two distant cries and a faint clean recording noise floor.

label: Tern calls
driver: Alternate passing seabird call; occasional spatial event rather than a continuous loop
prompt: One wild tern heard from the deck of a wooden sailing ship gives a single brief high, thin, slightly nasal rasping cry, about one second long. Sharp avian throat texture and a natural uneven falling pitch. A clean onset after a short silence, then a complete decay into quiet. Isolated outdoor field recording of this one tern call only.
